messages:
lucy: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring midnight p95 spikes (approx 00:30 UTC) tied to cache reseed + uneven traffic weights. Need clear owners for SLO/SLA changes, dashboards, and the recurring-playbook. Proposed: tighten prod p95 from 300ms -> 210ms staged, keep p99 at 950ms, and add a short-window guard (5m) to page earlier. Also change error-budget alert to 10m window at 0.7% burn. Who can take items?

omar: I can take SLO edits + migration notes. Plan: draft SLO PR that stages change in two canaries (eu-west, us-west) for 72h. Will include exact evaluation windows and a customer blurb. Target PR by Tue.

harper: Ill own dashboards + alerts. Will add: regional p95 heatmap, 5m guard panel, fallback-activation counter, and an error-budget burn panel with 10m window. Alert: `sum(increase(error_budget_burn[10m]))/sum(error_budget_total) > 0.007` -> page eng-sre. ETA staging dash Thu.

toni: Ill take the runbook/playbook update and triage checklist. Will add commands for cache inspection, example queries, and a short decision tree for when to trigger fallback routing. Runbook snippet:

```
# check cache evictions
curl -s "https://metrics/api/v1/query?query=sum(increase(cache_evictions_total[10m]))"
# quick fallback route
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://deploy.internal/api/v1/routes/fallback -d '{"policy":"light-quant"}'
```

lucy: Please link dashboard panels to runbook anchors so oncall can jump straight to commands. Also add a metric for `fallback_reason` label so we can filter by cache-related fallbacks.

omar: Good call. I'll add a note in the PR about Dedicated customer semantics and include a short FAQ entry for CS.

harper: ETA staging dash Wed evening. I'll include a small widget that shows canary vs global p95 so we can decide rollout.

toni: Runbook PR will include the \"midnight spike\" play and a checklist to verify sticky sessions and cache warmup. ETA Wed.

slo-bot: IncidentBot: postmortem entry created at 2200123700 -> https://infra/reports/2200123456

lucy: Assigning owners & due dates in the tracker:
- omar: SLO PR + migration notes  due 2026-04-06
- harper: dashboards + 10m alerts  due 2026-04-04
- toni: runbook + midnight-playbook  due 2026-04-03
We'll test in staging, run a canary for 72h, and reconvene in the SLO sync with fallback counts and customer impact notes. Ping if you need infra or help with the canary windows.

omar: Will open draft PR and include a canary rollout plan.

harper: Will post staging link when up.

toni: PR for runbook ready in 45m.

lucy: Thanks team. If canary shows increased fallback activations we pause rollout and revert SLO change. Keep p99 unchanged for now.
